recentItems.description:
Coming to you from two of India’s most sensational young artists, Chehra is a sweet, easy going, relatable song that talks about the everyday things that make love truly special. 
It highlights the moments that count- of love, care, little arguments / fights & but unhinged affection overall.

Chehra - Mitta Ror feat. Swara Verma is sure to make you fall in love, all over again.

और या बात ना पूछे क्यू होना चाइये
